entity.summary: Digital-asset and financial platform providing access to digital assets, commodities, stocks, payments, and related account services through its consumer and institutional products.
entity.notes: The current first-party platform presents digital-asset investment and trading access alongside banking, payment-card, commodity, and stock features. Dubai's Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority lists Fasset FZE under reference VL/23/07/002 with an active broker-dealer licence for institutional, qualified, and retail investors. The UAE origin value follows the reviewed Dubai-licensed operating entity. No exact launch date or cross-jurisdiction licence conclusion is inferred.
